mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( reservation_seq, order_id, payment_key, amount, status, requested_at, approved_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationSeq}, #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT payment_seq AS paymentSeq, reservation_seq AS reservationSeq, order_id AS orderId, payment_key AS paymentKey, amount, status, fail_reason AS failReason, requested_at AS requestedAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM payment WHERE reservation_seq = #{reservationSeq} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = #{status}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CANCELLED' THEN NOW() ELSE cancelled_at END WHERE payment_seq = #{paymentSeq}
